activePatientsWithNoMissingData: active patients with no missing data
activeRegistrantsDescription: Sex, age and disease of the active patients
activityExplanation: Activity lists what ACT's users change: forms, patients, users, roles, clinics, studies and flags. Changes to the server's own setup (concepts, form definitions, settings) stay in the audit module, for the same privilege.
allReportsDescription: Open a report as a table to sort and search it, then download what you see.
byFacilityDescription: Each patient's primary care clinic: active patients, mean adherence and data status (Duplicates: shared name and birth date, Review: open data-quality flag).
cannotStartVisit: You may not start a visit for this patient.
careCascadeDescription: Active RHD patients; each step is a share of the one before, Adherent of Initiated
careCascadePastDescription: Active RHD patients; each step is a share of the one before. Coverage and adherence are left out, as ACT Core keeps them only for today.
clinicalDashboardsCliniciansOnly: Clinical dashboards are only visible to clinicians.
completionNotBeforeEnrollment: The completion date cannot be before the enrollment date
confirmDismissFlag: Dismiss this flag? It stays dismissed until the data no longer raises it.
consentBeforeEnrolling: A patient is enrolled in a study only after giving registry consent, which is recorded at registration.
couldNotLoadCareCascade: Could not load the care cascade
couldNotLoadDueForProphylaxis: Could not load the patients due for prophylaxis

couldNotLoadParticipants: Could not load the study participants
couldNotLoadPatientsOnProphylaxis: Could not load the patients on prophylaxis

couldNotLoadWaitingList: Could not load the procedural waiting list
couldNotLoadWorklistPatients: Could not load the worklist patients
couldNotRecordDownload: Could not record the download, so no file was made
couldNotRefresh: Could not refresh flags and adherence
dateNotInFuture: The date cannot be in the future

diagnosisToConfirmTileDescription: Screened positive, no diagnosis details yet
disableUserBody: They will no longer be able to sign in. Everything they recorded stays, and an instance administrator can enable them again.
downloadDeidentifiedExplanation: A row for each saved form, without names, birth dates, ID numbers or phones. Each download is recorded.
downloadIdentifiedExplanation: A row for each saved form, with the patient's names, birth date, ID numbers and phones. Each download is recorded.
downloadResearchExplanation: A row for each saved form of the patients who opted in to research, without names, birth dates, ID numbers or phones. Each download is recorded.
downloadsExplanation: Every CSV that leaves ACT is here: Download data, the registry and worklist lists, and these logs. A download is recorded before its first row is sent; if it cannot be recorded, it does not happen.

endBeforeStart: The end is before the start
enterAStudyName: Enter a name for the study

enterTheCompletionDate: Enter the completion date for an Inactive status
everyReadInAuditModule: Every read in the audit module

referralNotSent: The referral could not be sent

registrantsByStatus_other: All {{count}} registrants, by where their registration stands
registrationsNotScreening: Counts registered patients, not people screened: a screen-negative child is never registered.
registryDescription: Patients enrolled in the RHD Registry programme

reportHasNoRows: The report has no rows for these dates
researchParticipantsOnly: Only those who opted in to research
restOfDashboardUpToDate: The rest of the Dashboard is up to date.
retainedInCare: Retained in care (seen in the last 7 months)
revisionInAuditModule: This change in the audit module (every field, every revision)
sameClinicAsUser: {{clinic}}, the same as the user's: expected
scanPatientCardExplanation: Point the camera at the barcode on the patient's identifier sticker to open their BPG Delivery form in their chart. The ACT ID field also takes a handheld barcode scanner.
